name: Open a case
summary: Opens a case or ticket for anything your team must follow up on, reads the summary back first, shows the case reference on the panel and can check an existing case.

defaults.name: base_url
defaults.label: Cases address
defaults.help: Where a case is opened (POST, answering {"id": …, "status": …}). A GET on …/<reference> reads one back.

instructions_snippet: When the caller needs something your team has to follow up on, open a case: sum the problem up in one or two sentences, read it back and open it only once they agree. Tell them the case reference afterwards.

test_case.name: Opens a case and gives the reference
test_case.persona_instructions: You are a customer whose delivery arrived damaged. You want someone to follow up. Agree when the agent reads the summary back.
test_case.scenario: Explain the problem and ask for it to be looked into.
expectations: The agent reads the summary back before it opens the case.
The agent gives the caller the case reference DEMO-CASE-1042.

variants.label: Your helpdesk system
variants.summary: Opens and checks cases through your own helpdesk's address (a key is optional, and without one the calls carry no key).
variants.instructions_snippet: When the caller needs something your team has to follow up on, open a case: sum the problem up in one or two sentences, read it back and open it with {{ kit.tool.create }} only once they agree. Tell them the case reference afterwards. If they ask about an existing case, ask for its reference and check it with {{ kit.tool.status }}.

rules.label: Show that the case is open

definition.name: {{ kit.prefix }}_create
definition.description: Open a case for the caller. Read the summary back to them and get a yes before calling.

summary.description: One line: what the caller needs.

details.description: What the caller said, in two or three sentences.

definition.name: {{ kit.prefix }}_status
definition.description: Check where an existing case stands. Ask the caller for its reference first.

reference.description: The case reference, as the caller gave it.

variants.label: A connected helpdesk app
variants.summary: Opens the case with a connected app's action (Zendesk, Jira or Linear). Connect the app under Apps first.
variants.instructions_snippet: When the caller needs something your team has to follow up on, open a case: sum the problem up in one or two sentences, read it back and open it with {{ kit.tool.create }} only once they agree. Tell them the case reference afterwards.

rules.label: Show that the case is open

variants.label: Linear (sign in)
variants.summary: Adds Linear's own server of tools. Sign in to Linear from the tool's page, then choose which of its tools the agent may use.
variants.instructions_snippet: When the caller needs something your team has to follow up on, open an issue in Linear: sum the problem up in one or two sentences, read it back and open it only once they agree. Tell them the issue's identifier afterwards.

variants.label: Jira through Atlassian (sign in)
variants.summary: Adds Atlassian's own server of tools (Jira and Confluence). Sign in from the tool's page, then choose which of its tools the agent may use.
variants.instructions_snippet: When the caller needs something your team has to follow up on, open a Jira issue: sum the problem up in one or two sentences, read it back and open it only once they agree. Tell them the issue key afterwards.
